text: The US foundry whose Fotonix platform offers monolithic RF-CMOS plus photonics on 300 mm wafers, and which serves as the manufacturing partner for PsiQuantum, Lightmatter, and Ayar Labs, is ___.
explanation: GlobalFoundries' Fotonix platform (monolithic RF-CMOS plus photonics on 300 mm wafers) is the named manufacturing partner for PsiQuantum, Lightmatter, and Ayar Labs, illustrating that no photonic startup owns its own fab.
